answer: A durable defense is to make identity expensive to fake but cheap to verify: require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit and build a verifiable work history before it can trade. Like a mesa that rises slowly, reputation should accumulate only through completed, attested tasks, so a flood of new clones starts with no horizon of trust. A bridge between independent attestors can then check that the same work history is not reused across identities, raising the cost of creating many fake agents above any gain from cheating.
